iddialar.baslik: Uncovering Neural Scaling Laws in Molecular Representation Learning
iddialar.gerekce: Addresses the open problem of neural scaling laws in molecular representation learning.

varlik_kodu.bulunan_baslik: Uncovering Neural Scaling Laws in Molecular Representation Learning

iddialar.kanit_alinti: the influence of both data quantity and quality on molecular representations is not yet clearly understood within this field.
iddialar.not: The work exists (NeurIPS 2023 D&B, arXiv 2309.15123). The abstract doesn't use the phrase 'open problem', but it presents the study of scaling laws in molecular representation learning as filling a gap, so the sentence is a fair paraphrase. I did not open the DOI landing page itself.

iddialar.baslik: Uncertainty Quantification Using Neural Networks for Molecular Property Prediction
iddialar.gerekce: Compares uncertainty quantification methods for molecular property prediction; none is unequivocally superior or reliably ranks errors across datasets.

varlik_kodu.bulunan_baslik:
Uncertainty Quantification Using Neural Networks for
Molecular Property Prediction

iddialar.kanit_alinti: none of the methods we tested is unequivocally superior to all others ... none produces a particularly reliable ranking of errors across multiple datasets
iddialar.not: The ACS page returned 403, so I checked the arXiv version (2005.10036) of the same paper. Its abstract matches the claim.

iddialar.gerekce: NetPlier offers probabilistic network protocol reverse engineering from message traces, supporting format inference for fuzzing.

iddialar.kanit_alinti: Network protocol reverse engineering is an important challenge with many security applications.

Fuzzing is not named in the abstract, and I couldn't read the PDF text to confirm it, so the fuzzing link is a plausible application rather

iddialar.baslik: How Powerful are Graph Neural Networks?
iddialar.gerekce: Characterizes discriminative power of popular GNN variants, showing they cannot distinguish certain simple graph structures; foundational expressivity theory.
iddialar.kanit_alinti: They show that popular variants, including Graph Convolutional Networks and GraphSAGE, cannot separate certain basic graph structures.
iddialar.not: Bu alıntı, arXiv özet sayfasının WebFetch ile alınan özetinden geliyor, doğrudan özet metninden değil. 'Foundational' ifadesi doğrulanamayan bir etki yargısı. Betimleyici kısım özetle uyuşuyor.

iddialar.baslik: Do Transformers Really Perform Bad for Graph Representation?
iddialar.gerekce: Graphormer shows that transformers with simple structural encodings can model graph-structured data effectively, a central graph transformer.
iddialar.kanit_alinti: we propose several simple yet effective structural encoding methods to help Graphormer better model graph-structured data
iddialar.not: The descriptive part is supported by the abstract; "a central graph transformer" is an unverifiable impact judgement, which I did not assess.

iddialar.gerekce: Stateful Greybox Fuzzing addresses reactive protocol implementations, targeting stateful bugs and state coverage without specifications.
iddialar.kanit_alinti: Many protocol implementations are reactive, so some bugs appear only in specific states. Reaching those states requires particular sequences of inputs, which is hard for a fuzzer without a formal protocol specification.
iddialar.not: The arXiv page's title and ID match. The abstract supports the sentence: it covers reactive protocols, stateful bugs, state coverage and no need for a specification. The quote is from the fetch tool's summary of the abstract, not the verbatim page text.

iddialar.baslik: Systematic Fuzzing and Testing of TLS Libraries
iddialar.gerekce: This work applies systematic fuzzing and testing to TLS libraries, a key protocol domain.

varlik_kodu.bulunan_baslik: Systematic Fuzzing and Testing of TLS Libraries

iddialar.kanit_alinti: TLS-Attacker, an open-source framework for evaluating the security of TLS libraries ... a two-stage fuzzing approach ... the TLS server behavior
iddialar.not: The search summary paraphrases the abstract, so the quote is not verbatim. The work exists with a matching title and DOI, and it does apply fuzzing and testing to TLS libraries. The 'key protocol domain' wording is a mild judgement, not a checkable fact.

iddialar.baslik: MolPROP: Molecular Property prediction with multimodal language and graph fusion
iddialar.gerekce: MolPROP fuses language models and graphs for property prediction, benchmarked on seven scaffold-split MoleculeNet datasets, exemplifying LLM integration.

varlik_kodu.bulunan_baslik: MolPROP: Molecular Property prediction with multimodal language and graph fusion

iddialar.kanit_alinti: We benchmark the MolPROP suite of models on seven scaffold split MoleculeNet datasets
iddialar.not: The paper exists and fuses the ChemBERTa-2 language model with graph neural networks on seven scaffold-split MoleculeNet datasets. The 'exemplifying LLM integration' wording is the tool's own framing, and ChemBERTa-2 is a small pretrained chemical language model rather than a typical LLM.

iddialar.gerekce: NequIP uses E(3)-equivariant convolutions on geometric tensors for data-efficient, accurate interatomic potentials, a landmark equivariant GNN.
